title: Cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees and the translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. This sketch consists of a closed loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin [0.0, 0.0] and ends at [0.0615, 0.0]. The second line starts at [0.0615, 0.0] and ends at [0.0615, 0.0096]. The third line starts at [0.0615, 0.0096] and ends at [0.0, 0.0096]. The fourth line completes the loop by starting at [0.0, 0.0096] and ending at the origin [0.0, 0.0]. After drawing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.0615 to the entire sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Finally, extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The resulting part is named "Cylinder" and has a length of 0.06153846153846154 units, a width of 0.009615384615384616 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the rectangular section
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0615, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0615, 0.0096) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0096) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the rectangular section
r = r.extrude(0.75)
